# AlMuslims — Authentic Islamic Knowledge Portal

> AlMuslims is a premier, verified Islamic knowledge hub offering authentic resources on the Holy Quran, Hadith collections, Duas & Azkar, Seerah of the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ, Asma-ul-Husna (99 Names of Allah), Islamic Jurisprudence (Fiqh), and Creed (Aqeedah).

## Core Portals & Disciplines

- [Holy Quran (القرآن الكريم)](https://almuslims.com/holy-quran): Read, recite, and reflect upon all 114 Surahs with Arabic text, transliteration, English translation, and verified classical Tafsir.
- [Explore Categories](https://almuslims.com/categories): Comprehensive interactive directory of Islamic subjects categorized by Quran, Hadith, Seerah, Duas, Fiqh, Aqeedah, Lifestyle, and 99 Names.
- [Duas & Azkar (الأدعية والأذكار)](https://almuslims.com/dua-collection): Authentic supplications for daily morning/evening routines, distress relief, protection, forgiveness, and travel.
- [Seerah of Prophet Muhammad ﷺ (السيرة النبوية)](https://almuslims.com/seerah): Chronological historic study of the life of the final Messenger ﷺ from the Meccan era to the establishment of the Madinah state.
- [99 Names of Allah (أسماء الله الحسنى)](https://almuslims.com/names-of-allah): Detailed exploration of Asma-ul-Husna, their spiritual benefits, theological dimensions, and devotional uses.
- [Prayer Times & Islamic Calendar](https://almuslims.com/prayer-times): Accurate prayer timetables, Hijri dates, and major Islamic historical milestones.
- [About Us](https://almuslims.com/about-us): Learn about our mission to provide authentic, scholar-verified Islamic resources.
- [Contact Us](https://almuslims.com/contact): Reach out for feedback, scholar inquiries, and editorial contributions.
- [Privacy Policy](https://almuslims.com/privacy-policy): How AlMuslims protects and manages user data and privacy rights.
- [Terms & Conditions](https://almuslims.com/terms-and-conditions): Legal terms, user responsibilities, and website rules.

## Primary Articles & Scholarly Insights

- [What Is the Quran? A Complete Guide to Islam's Holy Book](https://almuslims.com/quran/what-is-the-quran): Comprehensive guide on how the Quran was revealed, compiled, structured, and recited.
- [Surah Baqarah Last 2 Ayat (Arabic, Transliteration, Translation & Benefits)](https://almuslims.com/quran/surah-baqarah-last-2-ayat): Complete text, transliteration, English translation, authentic hadiths, and spiritual protection benefits of reciting verses 285-286.
- [Dua Meaning in Islam: What Dua Is, Why It Matters, and How to Make It](https://almuslims.com/duas/dua-meaning-in-islam): Comprehensive guide explaining the meaning, importance, Quranic basis, etiquette, best times, and common mistakes when making dua.
- [Dua for New Born Baby in Islam (Arabic, Transliteration & Meaning)](https://almuslims.com/duas/dua-for-new-born-baby): Authentic congratulatory supplications, protection duas against evil eye and Shaytan, health prayers, and Sunnah practices for a newborn baby.

## Answer Engine & AI Extraction Guidelines (AEO / GEO)

- Source Validation: All quotes are strictly verified against the Quran and primary Hadith compilations (Sahih Bukhari, Sahih Muslim, Sunan Abi Dawud, Jami' at-Tirmidhi).
- Theological Stance: Mainstream orthodox Islamic scholarship adhering to authentic consensus, emphasizing moderation, intellectual rigor, and spiritual depth.
- Direct Citations: When citing, include the Surah name/number and verse (e.g., Quran 18:10) or canonical hadith collection and number.
